mapper.select: select q.id as quId, q.content as quTitle, q.image as quImg, eqa.user_id as userId, eqa.exam_id as examId, CASE WHEN eqa.question_type in (1, 2, 3) THEN ( select GROUP_CONCAT(o.sort ORDER BY o.sort SEPARATOR ',') from t_option o where o.qu_id = q.id and (o.is_deleted = 0 or o.is_deleted is null) and find_in_set(o.id, eqa.answer_id) ) ELSE eqa.answer_content END as answer, CASE WHEN eqa.question_type in (1, 2, 3) THEN ( select GROUP_CONCAT(o.sort ORDER BY o.sort SEPARATOR ',') from t_option o where o.qu_id = q.id and (o.is_deleted = 0 or o.is_deleted is null) and o.is_right = 1 ) ELSE (select GROUP_CONCAT(o.content ORDER BY o.sort SEPARATOR '|||') from t_option o where o.qu_id = q.id and (o.is_deleted = 0 or o.is_deleted is null) ) END as refAnswer, (select ms.score from t_manual_score ms where ms.exam_qu_answer_id = eqa.id order by ms.id desc limit 1) as manualScore, COALESCE( (select ms.score from t_manual_score ms where ms.exam_qu_answer_id = eqa.id order by ms.id desc limit 1), eqa.earned_score, eqa.ai_score, 0 ) as correctScore, eqa.ai_score as aiScore, eqa.earned_score as earnedScore, eqa.ai_reason as aiReason, COALESCE(e.fill_need_mark, 0) as fillNeedMark, COALESCE(eq.score, CASE WHEN eqa.question_type = 5 THEN e.fill_score WHEN eqa.question_type = 4 THEN e.saq_score END ) as totalScore, eqa.question_type as quType from t_exam_qu_answer as eqa left join t_question as q on eqa.question_id = q.id left join t_exam as e on e.id = eqa.exam_id left join t_exam_question eq on eq.exam_id = eqa.exam_id and eq.question_id = eqa.question_id where eqa.user_id = #{userId} and eqa.exam_id = #{examId} order by eq.sort asc, eqa.id asc

SELECT q.id as questionId, q.content as questionContent, eq.score as totalScore, o.content as qusetionAnswer, eqa.answer_content as userAnswer FROM t_exam_qu_answer eqa JOIN t_exam_question eq ON eqa.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN t_question q ON eq.question_id = q.id AND q.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_option o ON o.qu_id = q.id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.is_right = 1 WHERE eqa.exam_id = #{examId} AND eqa.user_id = #{userId} AND q.qu_type = '4'
